BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AUTORT_VALID.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with autort set to rfc8365-compatible

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AUTORT_INVALID.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with autort set to an invalid value

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_ALL_VNI_TRUE.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with advertise-all-vni set to true

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_ALL_VNI_FALSE.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with advertise-all-vni set to false

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_ALL_VNI_INVALID.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with advertise-all-vni set to an invalid value

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_SVI_IP_TRUE.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with advertise-svi-ip set to true

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_SVI_IP_FALSE.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with advertise-svi-ip set to false

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_SVI_IP_INVALID.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with advertise-svi-ip set to an invalid value

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_DISAB.desc: BGP Address Family with install_backup_path set to disabled (explicit default)

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_PIC.desc: BGP Address Family with install_backup_path set to pic (single backup path)

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_PIC_E.desc: BGP Address Family with install_backup_path set to pic-ecmp (ECMP backup paths)

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_PIC_T.desc: BGP Address Family with install_backup_path set to pic-tunnel-only (tunnel-resolved backups only)

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_PIC_E.desc: BGP Address Family with install_backup_path set to pic-ecmp-tunnel-only

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_DIFFE.desc: install_backup_path can be set independently per address family: pic on ipv4, pic-ecmp on ipv6

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_INVAL.desc: BGP Address Family with install_backup_path set to an invalid enum value

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTALL_BACKUP_PATH_NON_U.desc: install_backup_path pic on a non-unicast AFI (l2vpn_evpn) must be rejected by the must constraint

BGP_GLOBALS_RR_CLUSTER_ID_INTEGER_VALID.desc: rr_cluster_id accepts a 32-bit integer (top of range, unambiguously not dotted-quad).

BGP_GLOBALS_RR_CLUSTER_ID_INVALID.desc: rr_cluster_id must reject a value that is neither an IPv4 address nor a 32-bit integer.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_SRPOLICY_INVALID.desc: BGP_GLOBALS_AF has no global AFI-SAFI configuration for SR-Policy SAFI; afi_safi=ipv4_srpolicy must be rejected outright by the restricted key type.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AFI_SAFI_HYPHENATED_INVAL.desc: BGP_GLOBALS_AF with a hyphenated afi_safi spelling (ipv4-unicast) must be rejected; the canonical form is underscore-separated.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AGGREGATE_ADDR_SRPOLICY_I.desc: BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AGGREGATE_ADDR with an SR-Policy afi_safi must be rejected by the restricted key type.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_NETWORK_SRPOLICY_INVALID.desc: BGP_GLOBALS_AF_NETWORK with an SR-Policy afi_safi must be rejected by the restricted key type.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_LINK_STATE_VALID.desc: BGP_GLOBALS_AF accepts afi_safi=link_state_link_state with distribute_bgp_fabric_link_state set; this is the CONFIG_DB equivalent of 'address-family link-state link-state' / 'distribute bgp-fabric-link-state' in FRR.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_LINK_STATE_INSTANCE_ID_VA.desc: BGP_GLOBALS_AF accepts distribute_bgp_fabric_link_state_instance_id under afi_safi=link_state_link_state; this is the CONFIG_DB equivalent of the optional 'instance-id WORD' argument of 'distribute bgp-fabric-link-state' in FRR.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_INSTANCE_ID_LINK_STATE_WR.desc: distribute_bgp_fabric_link_state_instance_id is only meaningful under afi_safi=link_state_link_state; setting it on ipv4_unicast must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: supported only for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_LINK_STATE_DISTRIBUTION_P.desc: BGP_GLOBALS_AF accepts distribution_policy under afi_safi=link_state_link_state, referencing an existing route-map; this is the CONFIG_DB equivalent of 'distribution-policy route-map <name>' in FRR.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_DISTRIBUTION_POLICY_LINK_.desc: distribution_policy is only meaningful under afi_safi=link_state_link_state; setting it on ipv4_unicast must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: supported only for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ROUTE_DISTANCE_LINK_STATE.desc: ebgp_route_distance (and ibgp_route_distance/local_route_distance, guarded identically) has no FRR command under address-family link-state link-state -- BGP-LS is a topology-distribution AF, not a route-carrying one, so admin-distance is meaningless there. Must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: ebgp_route_distance is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_IMPORT_VRF_LINK_STATE_INV.desc: import_vrf has no 'import vrf' command under address-family link-state link-state (BGP-LS is not route-carrying). Must be rejected on a link_state_link_state row even for a genuinely different, resolvable VRF -- otherwise this would only be caught by the separate, unrelated self-import guard when the value happens to equal the row's own vrf_name.
eStr: import_vrf is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_IMPORT_VRF_ROUTE_MAP_LINK.desc: import_vrf_route_map has no 'import vrf route-map' command under address-family link-state link-state. Must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: import_vrf_route_map is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AUTORT_LINK_STATE_INVALID.desc: autort is an L2VPN EVPN route-target-derivation knob with no FRR command under address-family link-state link-state. Must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: autort is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_ALL_VNI_LINK_ST.desc: advertise-all-vni is an L2VPN EVPN knob with no FRR command under address-family link-state link-state. Must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: advertise-all-vni is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_ADVERTISE_SVI_IP_LINK_STA.desc: advertise-svi-ip is an L2VPN EVPN knob with no FRR command under address-family link-state link-state. Must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: advertise-svi-ip is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_DISTRIBUTE_LINK_STATE_WRO.desc: distribute_bgp_fabric_link_state is only meaningful under afi_safi=link_state_link_state; setting it on ipv4_unicast must be rejected by the must guard on the leaf.
eStr: supported only for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AGGREGATE_ADDR_LINK_STATE.desc: BGP-LS is a topology-distribution AF, not a route-carrying one; FRR has no aggregate-address command under address-family link-state link-state. afi_safi=link_state_link_state must be rejected by the must guard on BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AGGREGATE_ADDR_LIST.afi_safi.
eStr: Aggregate-address is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_NETWORK_LINK_STATE_INVALI.desc: Same reasoning as BGP_GLOBALS_AF_AGGREGATE_ADDR_LINK_STATE_INVALID: FRR has no network command under address-family link-state link-state either.
eStr: Network statement is not supported for the link_state_link_state address family

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_L2VPN_EVPN_VALID.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF accepts l2vpn_evpn, which is required to activate a neighbor for EVPN.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_EMPTY_AUTH_PASSWORD_INVALID.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR with an empty auth_password must be rejected.

BGP_PEER_GROUP_EMPTY_AUTH_PASSWORD_INVAL.desc: BGP_PEER_GROUP with an empty auth_password must be rejected.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_LOCAL_ADDR_SUB_INTERFACE_VA.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR and BGP_PEER_GROUP local_addr name a configured VLAN sub-interface of a port or a portchannel, in full (Ethernet64.145, PortChannel1.10) and short (Eth64.146, Po1.20) form; frrcfgd renders it as update-source.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_LOCAL_ADDR_SUB_INTERFACE_NO.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR local_addr naming a sub-interface with no VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE row is rejected.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_LOCAL_ADDR_SUB_INTERFACE_OT.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR local_addr must spell the sub-interface as its VLAN_SUB_INTERFACE key: Ethernet64.145 does not match a configured Eth64.145.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_AFI_SAFI_HYPHENATED_INVA.desc: BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF with a hyphenated afi_safi spelling (ipv4-unicast) must be rejected; the canonical form is underscore-separated.

BGP_PEER_GROUP_AF_SRPOLICY_VALID.desc: BGP_PEER_GROUP_AF (with BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF) is one of only two tables carrying the full bgp_afi_safi vocabulary; both SR-Policy families must remain admissible keys.

BGP_PEER_GROUP_AF_AFI_SAFI_HYPHENATED_IN.desc: BGP_PEER_GROUP_AF with a hyphenated afi_safi spelling (ipv4-unicast) must be rejected; the canonical form is underscore-separated.

BGP_GLOBALS_LLGR_STALE_TIME_VALID.desc: BGP global with llgr_stale_time set to a valid value (3600s). LLGR can operate independently of GR per RFC 9494.

BGP_GLOBALS_LLGR_STALE_TIME_BELOW_RANGE_.desc: llgr_stale_time of 0 is below the valid range (1-16777215) and must be rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_LLGR_STALE_TIME_ABOVE_RANGE_.desc: llgr_stale_time of 16777216 exceeds the 24-bit capability field maximum and must be rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_GR_SELECT_DEFER_TIME_VALID.desc: BGP global with gr_select_defer_time set to 240s. Controls how long bgpd defers best-path selection after graceful restart.

BGP_GLOBALS_GR_SELECT_DEFER_TIME_ZERO_VA.desc: gr_select_defer_time of 0 is valid (disables the defer timer).

BGP_GLOBALS_GR_SELECT_DEFER_TIME_ABOVE_R.desc: gr_select_defer_time of 3601 exceeds the maximum of 3600 and must be rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_EBGP_REQUIRES_POLICY_VALID_T.desc: BGP global with ebgp_requires_policy set to true. Enforces RFC 8212 policy requirement on eBGP peers.

BGP_GLOBALS_EBGP_REQUIRES_POLICY_VALID_F.desc: BGP global with ebgp_requires_policy set to false. BGP session exchange routes without policy.

BGP_GLOBALS_EBGP_REQUIRES_POLICY_INVALID.desc: BGP global with ebgp_requires_policy does not accept int 0 as false.
BGP global with ebgp_requires_policy does not accept int !0 as true.

BGP_GLOBALS_BESTPATH_BANDWIDTH_IGNORE_VA.desc: bestpath_bandwidth of 'ignore' is accepted; the instance disregards received link-bandwidth, so every multipath gets equal weight.

BGP_GLOBALS_BESTPATH_BANDWIDTH_SKIP_MISS.desc: bestpath_bandwidth of 'skip-missing' is accepted; weighted ECMP stays active over the paths that do carry link-bandwidth, and only the paths lacking it leave the multipath set.

BGP_GLOBALS_BESTPATH_BANDWIDTH_DEFAULT_W.desc: bestpath_bandwidth of 'default-weight-for-missing' is accepted; paths without link-bandwidth get a weight of 1.

BGP_GLOBALS_BESTPATH_BANDWIDTH_NON_DEFAU.desc: bestpath_bandwidth is settable per-VRF: the default VRF and Vrf1 carry different values, each scoped to its own BGP instance.

BGP_GLOBALS_BESTPATH_BANDWIDTH_INVALID.desc: bestpath_bandwidth admits only the three defined keywords. 'ecmp' must be rejected -- plain-ECMP behaviour is expressed by omitting the leaf, not by a fourth enum value.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_VNET_VALID.desc: Configure BGP neighbor with a VNet name as vrf_name.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_VNET_NOT_EXIST.desc: BGP neighbor vrf_name references a non-existing VNet.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_EMPTY_NAME.desc: Template-based BGP neighbor description may be empty.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_NEG_LF_NAME.desc: Template-based BGP neighbor description contains LF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_NEG_CR_NAME.desc: Template-based BGP neighbor description contains CR.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_NEG_CRLF_NAME.desc: Template-based BGP neighbor description contains CRLF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_INVALID_ENFORCE_FIRST_A.desc: Invalid boolean value for enforce first AS.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_NAME.desc: Incorrect neighbor name in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAXTHRESHOLD.desc: Invalid maximum prefix warning threshold in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_SOFT_RECFG_I.desc: Invalid boolean value for soft reconfiguration-in in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_SEND_COMNTY.desc: Invalid value for send community type in neighbor AF.

BGP_PEER_GROUP_AF_NEG_PEER_GROUP_NOT_EXI.desc: Referring non-existing BGP peer group table.

BGP_PEERGROUP_INVALID_ENFORCE_FIRST_AS.desc: Invalid boolean value for enforce first AS.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_INVALID_MAXTHRESHOLD.desc: Invalid maximum prefix warning threshold in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_INVALID_SOFT_RECFG_IN.desc: Invalid boolean value for soft reconfiguration-in in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_INVALID_SEND_COMNTY.desc: Invalid value for send community type in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_ROUTE_MAP_VALID.desc: Validate route-map reference in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_ROUTE_MAP_NOT_EXIST.desc: Missing or non-existent route-map reference in peergroup AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_IN.desc: Invalid route-map in count in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_OUT.desc: Invalid route-map out count in neighbor AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_IN.desc: Invalid route-map in count in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_OUT.desc: Invalid route-map out count in peergroup AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_INVALID_HOPS.desc: Invalid TTL hops for unnumbered interface neigbhor.

BGP_MONITORS_NEG_MULTILINE_NAME.desc: BGP monitor description contains a newline.

BGP_PEERRANGE_VALID_VNET.desc: Configure BGP peer range with a valid vnet.

BGP_PEERRANGE_VALID_VRF.desc: Configure BGP peer range with a valid vrf.

BGP_PEERRANGE_INVALID_VNET_OR_VRF.desc: Configure BGP peer range with an invalid vnet or vrf.

BGP_SENTINEL_INVALID_NAME_MISMATCH.desc: Sentinel name must still equal its key.

BGP_SENTINEL_NEG_LF_EQUAL_NAMES.desc: Equal sentinel key and name containing LF fail the pattern, not equality.

BGP_SENTINEL_NEG_CR_EQUAL_NAMES.desc: Equal sentinel key and name containing CR fail the pattern, not equality.

BGP_SENTINEL_NEG_CRLF_EQUAL_NAMES.desc: Equal sentinel key and name containing CRLF fail the pattern, not equality.
